Further research on defense styles as outcome predictors in psychotherapies of different types is needed .
rewrite: Identifying pretreatment patient traits that predict psychotherapy outcomes could assist in guiding treatment decisions. This study examines patients' baseline immature defense style as a predictor for short-term versus long-term psychotherapy results. In the Helsinki Psychotherapy Study, 326 adult outpatients with mood or anxiety disorders were randomly assigned to individual short-term (psychodynamic or solution-focused) or long-term (psychodynamic) psychotherapy. Their defense style was evaluated at baseline using the 88-item Defense Style Questionnaire and categorized as low or high relative to the median score. Specific (Beck Depression Inventory [BDI], Hamilton Depression Rating Scale [HDRS], Symptom Check List Anxiety Scale [SCL-90-Anx], Hamilton Anxiety Rating Scale [HARS]) and global (Symptom Check List Global Severity Index [SCL-90-GSI], Global Assessment of Functioning Scale [GAF]) psychiatric symptoms were assessed at baseline and 3–7 times over a 3-year follow-up. Patients with high immature defense style use showed greater symptom reduction in long-term than in short-term psychotherapy by the end of the 3-year follow-up (50% vs. 34%). Those with low immature defense style use experienced faster symptom reduction in short-term than in long-term psychotherapy during the first follow-up year (34% vs. 19%). Understanding patients' initial immature defense style level may help tailor treatments. Further research on defense styles as outcome predictors across various psychotherapy types is warranted.

text: To evaluate the effect of olmesartan medoxomil tablets ( olmesartan ) in comparison with Olmetec on 24 h ambulatory blood pressure ( ABPM ) and blood pressure variability ( BPV ) in patients with mild to moderate hypertension . A randomized , double-blind , double-mimic controlled trial was performed.Forty-eight patients with mild to moderate essential hypertension were randomly into treatment group ( olmesartan ) and control group ( Olmetec ) for eight weeks . The ABPM was taken before and at the end of the trial . After eight weeks , treatment with olmesartan induced a significant reduction in ABPM in patients [ ( 9 3 ) / ( 11 3 ) mmHg ( 1 mmHg = 0.133 kPa ) ] , which is similar with the reduction by Olmetec [ ( 9 4 ) / ( 9 5 ) mmHg ] , P > 0.05 . This situation holds for BPV with the standard deviations of 24 h , systolic blood pressure/diastolic blood pressure of pre-treatment and pro-treatment were ( 10 2 ) / ( 11 3 ) mmHg vs ( 10 3 ) / ( 12 2 ) mmHg in olmesartan group , and ( 10 3 ) / ( 11 3 ) mmHg vs ( 12 3 ) / ( 12 4 ) mmHg in Olmetec group . ( 3 ) There is no difference in the rate of adverse event between olmesartan ( 10.42 % ) and Olmetec ( 8.33 % ) treatment ( P > 0.05 ) . Similar to Olmetec , treatment with olmesartan once daily can significantly reduce ABPM in patients with mild to moderate essential hypertension .
rewrite: This study assessed the impact of olmesartan medoxomil tablets versus Olmetec on 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure (ABPM) and blood pressure variability (BPV) in mild to moderate hypertensive patients. A randomized, double-blind, double-dummy controlled trial was conducted. Forty-eight patients with mild to moderate essential hypertension were randomly assigned to the treatment group (olmesartan) or the control group (Olmetec) for eight weeks. ABPM was measured before and after the trial. After eight weeks, olmesartan treatment led to a significant reduction in ABPM [ (93)/(113) mmHg (1 mmHg = 0.133 kPa) ], comparable to the reduction with Olmetec [ (94)/(95) mmHg ], P > 0.05. This pattern was also observed for BPV, where the standard deviations of 24-hour systolic/diastolic blood pressure pre- and post-treatment were (102)/(113) mmHg vs (103)/(122) mmHg in the olmesartan group, and (103)/(113) mmHg vs (123)/(124) mmHg in the Olmetec group. (3) No difference was found in the adverse event rate between olmesartan (10.42%) and Olmetec (8.33%) treatment (P > 0.05). Similar to Olmetec, once-daily olmesartan treatment can significantly lower ABPM in patients with mild to moderate essential hypertension.

text: We compare the frequency of airway and respiratory adverse events leading to an intervention between propofol with 1:1 and 4:1 mixtures of propofol and ketamine ( ketofol ) . We performed a randomized , double-blinded trial in which emergency department adults undergoing deep sedation received propofol , 1:1 propofol and ketamine , or 4:1 propofol and ketamine . Our primary outcome was the frequency of airway and respiratory adverse events leading to an intervention . Other outcomes included sedation depth , efficacy , procedure and recovery time , patient satisfaction , pain , and procedural recall . Two hundred seventy-one subjects completed the trial , 90 receiving propofol , 85 receiving 1:1 propofol and ketamine , and 96 receiving 4:1 propofol and ketamine . Airway or respiratory adverse events leading to an intervention were similar between groups : 29 % , 19 % , and 32 % , respectively ( P = .21 ) . There were no serious adverse events in any group . Secondary outcomes were generally similar between groups , with greater recovery agitation observed in the 1:1 ketofol group ( 8 % , 21 % , and 10 % , respectively ) . We found a similar frequency of airway and respiratory adverse events leading to intervention between propofol alone and either 1:1 or 4:1 ketofol .
rewrite: We assessed the incidence of airway and respiratory adverse events requiring intervention for propofol alone versus 1:1 and 4:1 mixtures of propofol and ketamine (ketofol). A randomized, double-blinded trial was conducted in the emergency department involving adults undergoing deep sedation who received either propofol, 1:1 ketofol, or 4:1 ketofol. The primary outcome was the frequency of airway and respiratory adverse events necessitating intervention. Secondary outcomes included sedation depth, efficacy, procedure and recovery durations, patient satisfaction, pain, and procedural recall. Of the 271 subjects who completed the trial, 90 received propofol, 85 received 1:1 ketofol, and 96 received 4:1 ketofol. The occurrence of airway or respiratory adverse events leading to intervention was comparable across groups: 29%, 19%, and 32%, respectively (P = .21). No serious adverse events occurred in any group. Most secondary outcomes were generally similar, though greater recovery agitation was noted in the 1:1 ketofol group (8%, 21%, and 10%, respectively). We observed a comparable frequency of airway and respiratory adverse events requiring intervention between propofol alone and both 1:1 and 4:1 ketofol.

text: Larger biopsy specimens or increasing the number of biopsies may improve the diagnostic accuracy of gastric epithelial neoplasia ( GEN ) . The aims of this study was to compare the diagnostic accuracies between conventional and jumbo forceps biopsy of GEN before endoscopic submucosal dissection ( ESD ) and to confirm that increasing the number of biopsies is useful for the diagnosis of GEN. The concordance rate between EFB and ESD specimens was not significantly different between the two groups [ 83.1 % ( 54/65 ) in JG vs. 79.1 % ( 53/67 ) in CG ] . On multivariate analyses , two or four EFBs significantly increased the cumulating concordance rate [ coefficients ; twice : 5.1 ( P = 0.01 ) , four times : 5.9 ( P = 0.02 ) ] . But , the concordance rate was decreased in high grade dysplasia ( coefficient -40.32 , P = 0.006 ) . One hundred and sixty GENs from 148 patients were randomized into two groups and finally 67 GENs in 61 patients and 65 GENs in 63 patients were allocated to the conventional group ( CG ) or jumbo group ( JG ) , respectively . Four endoscopic forceps biopsy ( EFB ) specimens were obtained from each lesion with conventional ( 6.8 mm ) forceps or jumbo ( 8 mm ) forceps . The histological concordance rate between 4 EFB specimens and ESD specimens was investigated in the two groups . Before ESD , the diagnostic accuracy of GENs was significantly increased not by the use of jumbo forceps biopsy but by increasing the number of biopsies .
rewrite: Using larger biopsy samples or taking more biopsies can enhance diagnostic precision for gastric epithelial neoplasia (GEN). This study aimed to compare diagnostic accuracy between conventional and jumbo forceps biopsies for GEN prior to endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD) and to verify that additional biopsies aid in diagnosing GEN. Concordance rates between EFB and ESD specimens showed no significant difference between groups [83.1% (54/65) in JG vs. 79.1% (53/67) in CG]. Multivariate analysis indicated that two or four EFBs notably raised the cumulative concordance rate [coefficients; twice: 5.1 (P=0.01), four times: 5.9 (P=0.02)]. However, concordance decreased for high-grade dysplasia (coefficient -40.32, P=0.006). A total of 160 GENs from 148 patients were randomly divided into two groups, resulting in 67 GENs in 61 patients and 65 GENs in 63 patients assigned to the conventional group (CG) or jumbo group (JG), respectively. Four endoscopic forceps biopsy (EFB) specimens were collected from each lesion using conventional (6.8 mm) or jumbo (8 mm) forceps. Histological concordance between the four EFB specimens and ESD specimens was examined in both groups. Before ESD, diagnostic accuracy for GENs was significantly improved not by jumbo forceps biopsy but by increasing the number of biopsies taken.

text: We previously demonstrated the feasibility and clinical effectiveness of a web-based assessment following total hip or total knee arthroplasty . The purpose of the present study was to conduct an economic evaluation to compare a web-based assessment with in-person follow-up . Patients who had undergone total joint arthroplasty at least twelve months previously were randomized to complete a web-based follow-up or visit the clinic for the usual follow-up . We recorded travel costs and time associated with each option . We followed patients for one year after the web-based or in-person follow-up evaluation and documented any resource use related to the joint arthroplasty . We conducted cost analyses from the health-care payer ( Ontario Ministry of Health and Long-Term Care ) and societal perspectives . All costs are presented in 2012 Canadian dollars . A total of 229 patients ( 118 in the web-based group , 111 in the usual-care group ) completed the study . The mean cost of the assessment from the societal perspective was $ 98 per patient for the web-based assessment and $ 162 per patient for the usual method of in-person follow-up . The cost for the web-based assessment was significantly lower from the societal perspective ( mean difference , $ -64 ; 95 % confidence interval [ CI ] , $ -79 to $ -48 ; p < 0.01 ) and also from the health-care payer perspective ( mean difference , $ -27 ; 95 % CI , $ -29 to $ -25 ; p < 0.01 ) . The web-based follow-up assessment had a lower cost per patient compared with in-person follow-up from both societal and health-care payer perspectives .
rewrite: Our earlier research confirmed the viability and clinical utility of online assessments after total hip or knee arthroplasty. This study aimed to perform an economic analysis comparing web-based follow-up with traditional in-person visits. Patients who had total joint arthroplasty at least twelve months prior were randomly assigned to either complete an online follow-up or attend a standard clinic appointment. We tracked travel expenses and time for each approach. Over the year following the web-based or in-person evaluation, we monitored any resource utilization linked to the joint arthroplasty. Cost analyses were carried out from both the health-care payer (Ontario Ministry of Health and Long-Term Care) and societal viewpoints, with all costs in 2012 Canadian dollars. In total, 229 patients (118 in the web-based group, 111 in the usual-care group) finished the study. From a societal perspective, the average assessment cost was $98 per patient for the web-based method and $162 for in-person follow-up. The web-based assessment was significantly less costly from the societal perspective (mean difference, -$64; 95% CI, -$79 to -$48; p < 0.01) and from the health-care payer perspective (mean difference, -$27; 95% CI, -$29 to -$25; p < 0.01). Thus, web-based follow-up incurred lower per-patient costs than in-person follow-up from both societal and health-care payer perspectives.

text: To compare clerkship medical students ' confidence in performing a simulated normal vaginal delivery ( NVD ) after participating in a simulation training session using two different models . Medical students were randomized to participate in a simulated NVD session using either an obstetrics mannequin or a birthing pelvis model . Questionnaires were used to assess confidence and evaluate the simulation before and immediately after the session and on the last day of the obstetrics clerkship rotation . One hundred ten students were randomized . At the start of the clerkship , both groups had similar obstetrics exposure and confidence levels . Only 15 students ( 13.9 % ) agreed they were ready to attempt a NVD with minimal supervision or independently . This increased significantly to 43 students ( 39.4 % ) immediately after the session . At the end of the clerkship , 79 of 81 responding students ( 97.5 % ) were confident that they could attempt a NVD with minimal supervision or independently . There were no significant differences noted between simulator groups at any point . The sessions were rated as equally useful and realistic , and this remained unchanged at the end of the clerkship . Simulated NVD training using either an obstetrics mannequin or a birthing pelvis model provides clerkship students with a positive experience and increases confidence immediately . It should be implemented early in the rotation , as it appears the clerkship experience also plays a large role in terms of students ' confidence . Despite this , students maintain this type of learning is useful . Effective simulation training can easily be incorporated into clerkship training .
rewrite: This study compared clerkship medical students' confidence in performing a simulated normal vaginal delivery (NVD) after training with two different models. Students were randomized to a simulation session using either an obstetrics mannequin or a birthing pelvis model. Questionnaires assessed confidence and evaluated the simulation before, immediately after the session, and on the final day of the obstetrics clerkship. One hundred ten students were randomized. Initially, both groups had comparable obstetrics exposure and confidence. Only 15 students (13.9%) felt ready to attempt an NVD with minimal supervision or independently. This rose significantly to 43 students (39.4%) right after the session. By the clerkship's end, 79 of 81 respondents (97.5%) were confident they could attempt an NVD with minimal or no supervision. No significant differences were found between the simulator groups at any assessment. Both sessions were rated as equally useful and realistic, a perception that persisted through the clerkship. Simulated NVD training with either an obstetrics mannequin or a birthing pelvis model offers clerkship students a positive experience and boosts confidence promptly. It should be introduced early in the rotation, as the overall clerkship experience also significantly influences student confidence. Nevertheless, students consistently find this learning method valuable. Effective simulation training can be readily integrated into clerkship programs.

text: Characterization of the variations in the metabolomic profiles of elderly people is a necessary step to understand changes associated with aging . This study assessed whether diets with different fat quality and supplementation with coenzyme Q10 ( CoQ ) affect the metabolomic profile in urine analyzed by proton nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy from elderly people . Ten participants received , in a cross-over design , four isocaloric diets for 4-week periods each : Mediterranean diet supplemented with CoQ ( Med + CoQ diet ) ; Mediterranean diet ; Western diet rich in saturated fat diet ; low-fat , high-carbohydrate diet enriched in n-3 polyunsaturated fat . Multivariate analysis showed differences between diets when comparing Med + CoQ diet and saturated fat diet , with greater hippurate urine levels after Med + CoQ diet and higher phenylacetylglycine levels after saturated fat diet in women . Following consumption of Med + CoQ , hippurate excretion was positively correlated with CoQ and - carotene plasma levels and inversely related to Nrf2 , thioredoxin , superoxide dismutase 1 , and gp91 ( phox ) subunit of NADPH oxidase gene expression . After saturated fat diet consumption , phenylacetylglycine excretion was inversely related to CoQ plasma level and positively correlated with isoprostanes urinary level . The association between hippurate excretion and antioxidant biomarkers along with the relationship between phenylacetylglycine excretion and oxidant biomarkers suggests that the long-term consumption of a Med + CoQ diet could be beneficial for healthy aging and a promising challenge in the prevention of processes related to chronic oxidative stress , such as cardiovascular and neurodegenerative disease .
rewrite: Characterizing variations in the metabolomic profiles of older adults is essential for understanding aging-related changes. This study evaluated whether diets differing in fat quality and coenzyme Q10 (CoQ) supplementation influence the urine metabolomic profile, analyzed via proton nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, in elderly individuals. In a crossover design, ten participants consumed four isocaloric diets for four weeks each: a Mediterranean diet with CoQ (Med+CoQ diet); a Mediterranean diet; a Western diet high in saturated fat; and a low-fat, high-carbohydrate diet rich in n-3 polyunsaturated fat. Multivariate analysis revealed differences between the Med+CoQ diet and the saturated fat diet, with higher urinary hippurate levels after the Med+CoQ diet and elevated phenylacetylglycine levels after the saturated fat diet in women. Following the Med+CoQ diet, hippurate excretion positively correlated with plasma CoQ and β-carotene levels and inversely with Nrf2, thioredoxin, superoxide dismutase 1, and gp91(phox) subunit of NADPH oxidase gene expression. After the saturated fat diet, phenylacetylglycine excretion inversely correlated with plasma CoQ levels and positively with urinary isoprostanes. The link between hippurate excretion and antioxidant biomarkers, alongside the association of phenylacetylglycine excretion with oxidant biomarkers, indicates that long-term adherence to a Med+CoQ diet may support healthy aging and offer a promising approach to preventing chronic oxidative stress-related processes, such as cardiovascular and neurodegenerative diseases.

text: Individuals with HIV infection and peripheral metabolic complications have impaired basal myocardial insulin sensitivity that is related to left ventricular ( LV ) diastolic dysfunction . It is unknown whether interventions shown to be effective in improving peripheral insulin sensitivity can improve basal myocardial insulin sensitivity and diastolic function in people with HIV and peripheral metabolic complications . In a pilot study , we evaluated whether the peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor-gamma ( PPAR - ) agonist pioglitazone or combined endurance and resistance exercise training improves basal myocardial insulin sensitivity and diastolic function in HIV + adults with peripheral metabolic complications . Twenty-four HIV + adults with metabolic complications including peripheral insulin resistance were randomly assigned to 4 months of pioglitazone ( PIO ; 30 mg/d ) or supervised , progressive endurance and resistance exercise training ( EXS ; 90-120 min/d , 3 d/wk ) . Basal myocardial substrate metabolism was quantified by radioisotope tracer methodology and positron emission tomography ( PET ) imaging , and LV function was measured by echocardiography . Twenty participants completed the study . Neither PIO nor EXS resulted in a detectable improvement in basal myocardial insulin sensitivity or diastolic function . Post hoc analyses revealed sample sizes of more than 100 participants are needed to detect significant effects of these interventions on basal myocardial insulin sensitivity and function . PIO or EXS alone did not significantly increase basal myocardial insulin sensitivity or LV diastolic function in HIV + individuals with peripheral metabolic complications .
rewrite: People living with HIV who have peripheral metabolic issues exhibit reduced basal myocardial insulin sensitivity, which is associated with left ventricular (LV) diastolic dysfunction. It remains unclear if treatments proven to enhance peripheral insulin sensitivity can also boost basal myocardial insulin sensitivity and diastolic function in this population. In a pilot trial, we assessed whether the PPAR-gamma agonist pioglitazone or a regimen of combined endurance and resistance exercise training enhances basal myocardial insulin sensitivity and diastolic function in HIV-positive adults with peripheral metabolic complications. Twenty-four HIV-positive adults with metabolic complications, including peripheral insulin resistance, were randomly allocated to four months of pioglitazone (PIO; 30 mg/day) or supervised, progressive endurance and resistance exercise training (EXS; 90-120 min/day, 3 days/week). Basal myocardial substrate metabolism was measured using radioisotope tracer methods and positron emission tomography (PET) imaging, while LV function was evaluated via echocardiography. Twenty participants finished the study. Neither PIO nor EXS produced a measurable improvement in basal myocardial insulin sensitivity or diastolic function. Post hoc analysis indicated that sample sizes exceeding 100 participants would be required to identify significant effects of these interventions on basal myocardial insulin sensitivity and function. PIO or EXS alone did not meaningfully improve basal myocardial insulin sensitivity or LV diastolic function in HIV-positive individuals with peripheral metabolic complications.

text: There is a shortage of literature describing the experience of individuals who have participated in a physical activity and mobile health ( mHealth ) intervention . Many physical activity interventions are of short duration and do not report long-term changes in clinical measures or adoption of prescribed health behaviors . Previously , we have reported the clinical and behavioral outcomes from the first phase of a physical activity prescription and mHealth intervention delivered through the primary care setting . The purpose of this next phase is to perform a longitudinal follow-up 6-months postintervention . Mixed methods analysis including repeated measures ANOVA of functional aerobic capacity ( VO2max ) at preintervention , postintervention , and follow-up clinic visits , and whole text analysis of semistructured interviews discussing the participant experience in a health behavior intervention . Twenty participants , mean age 63 5 years , participated . Gains made in VO2max were maintained at 6 months ( P < 0.05 ) . Participants reported engaging in sustained and routine physical activity , yet some identified a need for additional support to adopt the prescribed health behaviors . Emergent themes included the desire for short-term mHealth intervention to educate individuals about prescribed health behaviors without need for ongoing management by clinicians , leveraging mHealth to build social networks around prescribed health behaviors and to connect individuals to build a sense of community , and participant views of physical activity as medicine . The present study investigated both the long-term adoption of physical activity behaviors as well as the participant experience in a physical activity and mHealth intervention . Findings from the current study may be used to inform the development of user-centered lifestyle interventions .
rewrite: There is limited literature on the experiences of individuals engaged in physical activity and mobile health (mHealth) interventions. Most physical activity programs are brief and lack long-term data on clinical outcomes or adherence to recommended health behaviors. Previously, we published clinical and behavioral results from the initial phase of a primary care-based physical activity prescription and mHealth intervention. This subsequent phase aims to conduct a longitudinal follow-up six months after the intervention. Mixed methods were used, including repeated measures ANOVA of functional aerobic capacity (VO2max) at preintervention, postintervention, and follow-up visits, along with whole text analysis of semistructured interviews on participant experiences in a health behavior intervention. Twenty participants, average age 63.5 years, took part. Improvements in VO2max were sustained at six months (P < 0.05). Participants reported maintaining regular physical activity, though some expressed a need for further support to adopt prescribed health behaviors. Key themes included the preference for short-term mHealth interventions to educate on health behaviors without continuous clinician oversight, using mHealth to create social networks and foster community around these behaviors, and viewing physical activity as medicine. This study examined both long-term physical activity adoption and participant experiences in a combined physical activity and mHealth intervention. The findings can guide the design of user-focused lifestyle interventions.

text: This study analyzed liver function abnormalities in heart failure patients admitted with severe acute decompensated heart failure ( ADHF ) . A post hoc analysis was conducted with the use of data from the Evaluation Study of Congestive Heart Failure and Pulmonary Artery Catheterization Effectiveness ( ESCAPE ) . Liver function tests ( LFTs ) were measured at 7 time points from baseline , at discharge , and up to 6 months follow-up . Survival analyses were used to assess the association between admission Model of End-Stage Liver Disease Excluding International Normalized Ratio ( MELD-XI ) scores and patient outcome.There was a high prevalence of abnormal baseline ( admission ) LFTs ( albumin 23.8 % , aspartate transaminase 23.5 % , alanine transaminase 23.8 % , and total bilirubin 36.1 % ) . The percentage of patients with abnormal LFTs decreased significantly from baseline to 6-months ' follow-up . When mean hemodynamic profiles were compared in patients with abnormal versus normal LFTs , elevated total bilirubin was associated with a significantly lower cardiac index ( 1.80 vs 2.1 ; P < .001 ) and higher central venous pressure ( 14.2 vs 12.0 ; P = .03 ) . Multivariable analyses revealed that patients with elevated MELD-XI scores ( 16.8 ) had a 2-fold ( hazard ratio2 .06 , 95 % confidence interval 1.05-4 .03 ) increased risk of death , rehospitalization , or transplantation after adjusting for baseline LFTs , age , sex , race , body mass index , diabetes , and systolic blood pressure . Abnormal LFTs are common in the ADHF population and are a dynamic marker of an impaired hemodynamic state . Elevated MELD-XI scores are associated with poor outcomes among patients admitted with ADHF .
rewrite: This research examined liver function irregularities in individuals hospitalized for severe acute decompensated heart failure (ADHF). A post hoc analysis was performed using data from the Evaluation Study of Congestive Heart Failure and Pulmonary Artery Catheterization Effectiveness (ESCAPE). Liver function tests (LFTs) were assessed at seven intervals from admission through discharge and up to six months of follow-up. Survival analyses evaluated the link between admission MELD-XI scores and clinical outcomes. A high frequency of abnormal baseline LFTs was observed (albumin 23.8%, AST 23.5%, ALT 23.8%, total bilirubin 36.1%). The proportion of patients with abnormal LFTs declined markedly from baseline to the six-month follow-up. Comparing hemodynamic profiles, elevated total bilirubin correlated with a significantly lower cardiac index (1.80 vs. 2.1; P<.001) and higher central venous pressure (14.2 vs. 12.0; P=.03). Multivariable analysis showed that patients with higher MELD-XI scores (16.8) had a doubled risk (HR 2.06, 95% CI 1.05–4.03) of mortality, rehospitalization, or transplantation after adjusting for baseline LFTs, age, sex, race, BMI, diabetes, and systolic blood pressure. Abnormal LFTs are prevalent in ADHF patients and serve as a dynamic indicator of compromised hemodynamics. Elevated MELD-XI scores are linked to adverse outcomes in those admitted with ADHF.

text: Lithium has proven suicide preventing effects in the long-term treatment of patients with affective disorders . Clinical evidence from case reports indicate that this effect may occur early on at the beginning of lithium treatment . The impact of lithium treatment on acute suicidal thoughts and/or behavior has not been systematically studied in a controlled trial . The primary objective of this confirmatory study is to determine the association between lithium therapy and acute suicidal ideation and/or suicidal behavior in inpatients with a major depressive episode ( MDE , unipolar and bipolar disorder according to DSM IV criteria ) . The specific aim is to test the hypothesis that lithium plus treatment as usual ( TAU ) , compared to placebo plus TAU , results in a significantly greater decrease in suicidal ideation and/or behavior over 5weeks in inpatients with MDE . We initiated a randomized , placebo-controlled multicenter trial . Patients with the diagnosis of a moderate to severe depressive episode and suicidal thoughts and/or suicidal behavior measured with the Sheehan-Suicidality-Tracking Scale ( S-STS ) will be randomly allocated to add lithium or placebo to their treatment as usual . Change in the clinician administered S-STS from the initial to the final visit will be the primary outcome . There is an urgent need to identify treatments that will acutely decrease suicidal ideation and/or suicidal behavior . The results of this study will demonstrate whether lithium reduces suicidal ideation and behavior within the first 5weeks of treatment . ClinicalTrials.gov identifier : NCT02039479 .
rewrite: Lithium demonstrates long-term suicide prevention effects in patients with affective disorders. Clinical case reports suggest this effect may emerge early in treatment. However, the impact of lithium on acute suicidal thoughts and behavior has not been systematically examined in controlled trials. This confirmatory study primarily aims to assess the association between lithium therapy and acute suicidal ideation and/or behavior in inpatients experiencing a major depressive episode (MDE, including unipolar and bipolar disorder per DSM-IV criteria). Specifically, it tests the hypothesis that lithium added to treatment as usual (TAU), compared to placebo plus TAU, leads to a significantly greater reduction in suicidal ideation and/or behavior over five weeks in inpatients with MDE. We have launched a randomized, placebo-controlled multicenter trial. Patients diagnosed with a moderate to severe depressive episode and suicidal thoughts and/or behavior, as measured by the Sheehan-Suicidality-Tracking Scale (S-STS), will be randomly assigned to receive either lithium or placebo in addition to their usual treatment. The primary outcome is the change in the clinician-administered S-STS score from baseline to the final visit. There is a pressing need to identify treatments that rapidly reduce suicidal ideation and behavior. This study’s findings will indicate whether lithium decreases suicidal ideation and behavior within the initial five weeks of treatment. ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT02039479.

text: Patients with end-stage renal disease are at a high risk of adverse cardiovascular events . Elevated level of homocysteine is an important risk factor for cardiovascular morbidity and mortality in dialysis patients . There are some strategies for reduction of serum homocysteine level in these patients , including folate and vitamin supplementation . The aim of the present study was to evaluate the effect of omega-3 supplementation on serum homocysteine level in patients on hemodialysis . In a randomized controlled trial , 100 hemodialysis patients were assigned into two groups to receive omega-3 ( oral capsule , 3 g/d ) or placebo for 2 months . Complete blood count , blood urea nitrogen , serum creatinine , serum lipids , and serum homocysteine levels were measured before the study and after 2 months at the end of study . Of 100 patients , 6 in each group were excluded , and 44 patients in each group completed the study . There were no significant differences regarding the age , sex , and the number of dialysis sessions per week between the two groups . No difference was observed between the two groups in the laboratory investigations at the end of the study , except for a significant reduction in serum homocysteine level in the omega-3 group as compared to the placebo group ( P = .03 ) . Our study showed a significant reduction regulated by omega-3 supplementation in serum homocysteine level which is a cardiovascular risk factor among hemodialysis patients . Omega-3 can be considered as another homocysteine-reducing agent in this population .
rewrite: Individuals with end-stage renal disease face a heightened risk of serious cardiovascular complications. High homocysteine levels are a key factor contributing to cardiovascular illness and death in those undergoing dialysis. Several approaches exist to lower serum homocysteine in these patients, such as folate and vitamin supplements. This study aimed to assess the impact of omega-3 supplementation on serum homocysteine levels in hemodialysis patients. In a randomized controlled trial, 100 hemodialysis patients were divided into two groups to take either omega-3 (oral capsules, 3 g/day) or a placebo for two months. Complete blood count, blood urea nitrogen, serum creatinine, serum lipids, and serum homocysteine were measured before and after the two-month study period. Out of 100 patients, six from each group were excluded, leaving 44 in each group who finished the study. Age, sex, and weekly dialysis sessions did not differ significantly between the groups. At the study's conclusion, laboratory results showed no differences between groups, except for a notable decrease in serum homocysteine in the omega-3 group compared to the placebo group (P = .03). Our findings indicate that omega-3 supplementation significantly reduces serum homocysteine, a cardiovascular risk factor, in hemodialysis patients. Omega-3 may be regarded as an additional agent for lowering homocysteine in this population.

text: The aim of this study was to investigate the effects of gonadotropin releasing hormone analog ( GnRHa ) therapy on normalized testicular atrophy index ( TAIn ) using gonadorelin before and after orchiopexy . 62 infants with 87 undescended testes ( UDT ) were prospectively assigned to two homogeneous groups according to age , position of UDT and TAIn . The patients were randomized to receive either orchiopexy alone or orchiopexy combined with GnRHa as nasal spray at 1.2 mg daily for 4 weeks before surgery and 4 weeks after surgery . Surgical approaches were relative to the position of the UDT : Shoemakers technique in proximal-UDT and Bianchi technique in distal-UDT . All the patients were evaluated clinically and sonographically 1 month before surgery , at the time of surgery , 1 month , 6 months and 5 years after surgery . Ultrasound data in our study have shown a statistically significant decrease of TAIn in children given additional HT only after 5 years of follow-up , in unilateral cases and in the entirety of treated patients ; in bilateral cases this difference was not statistically significant . Patients with a TAIn > 20 % treated with preoperative and post-operative GnRHa therapy have a significant increase in testicular volume after 5 years of follow-up , as shown by the relative reduction of TAIn values .
rewrite: This study aimed to examine the impact of gonadotropin-releasing hormone analog (GnRHa) therapy on the normalized testicular atrophy index (TAIn) using gonadorelin before and after orchiopexy. Sixty-two infants with 87 undescended testes (UDT) were prospectively divided into two comparable groups based on age, UDT position, and TAIn. Participants were randomly assigned to undergo orchiopexy alone or orchiopexy plus GnRHa nasal spray at 1.2 mg daily for four weeks pre-surgery and four weeks post-surgery. Surgical methods corresponded to UDT location: the Shoemakers technique for proximal-UDT and the Bianchi technique for distal-UDT. All patients underwent clinical and ultrasound evaluations one month before surgery, at surgery, and one month, six months, and five years after surgery. Ultrasound results indicated a statistically significant reduction in TAIn only after five years of follow-up in children receiving additional hormone therapy, specifically in unilateral cases and overall treated patients; this difference was not statistically significant in bilateral cases. Patients with a TAIn >20% who received pre- and post-operative GnRHa therapy showed a significant increase in testicular volume after five years, as evidenced by a relative decrease in TAIn values.

text: This study compares the effectiveness of three treating methods including behavioral mother training ( BMT ) , Verbal self-instruction to the children ( VSI ) , and pharmacotherapy in children with attention deficit-hyperactivity disorder ( ADHD ) using the continuous performance test ( CPT ) . In this semi-experimental study , 51 elementary students were identified in a boys ' school in Shiraz ( age 8-10 ) with attention deficit-hyperactivity disorder in a pilot study ( among 1760 students ) . They were randomly divided into three groups ; BMT , VSI , and control group . Moreover , 22 students were selected with ADHD among the clients in Hafez hospital . They were chosen by the availability method and they were put into the Pharmacotherapy group . Data collection tools were the Child Symptoms Inventory ( CSI-4 ) and the continuous performance test . All of the groups were evaluated after the intervention and in post-test and also 2 months later in follow up . The treatment type ( group ) showed statistically significant difference in the result of CPT on severity of attention-deficit and in the number of correct responses ( P = 0.01 ) , yet on the hyperactivity symptoms , there was no significant difference between the different treatment groups ( P = 0.08 ) . The time factor shows a significant difference among the different groups ( p < 0.001 ) . Comparison of the various treatments of ADHD indicates that pharmacotherapy can improve the severity of attention deficit and the number of correct answers of children with ADHD .
rewrite: This research evaluates the efficacy of three treatment approaches—behavioral mother training (BMT), verbal self-instruction for children (VSI), and pharmacotherapy—for attention deficit-hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) in children, using the continuous performance test (CPT). In this semi-experimental design, 51 elementary school boys (aged 8–10) with ADHD were identified from a pilot study among 1,760 students at a school in Shiraz. They were randomly assigned to three groups: BMT, VSI, and a control group. Additionally, 22 children with ADHD were selected from clients at Hafez Hospital via convenience sampling and placed in the pharmacotherapy group. Assessment tools included the Child Symptoms Inventory (CSI-4) and the CPT. All groups were assessed post-intervention, at a follow-up test, and again after two months. Treatment type (group) showed a statistically significant effect on CPT results for attention-deficit severity and correct response count (P = 0.01), but no significant difference was found among groups for hyperactivity symptoms (P = 0.08). The time factor demonstrated a significant difference across groups (p < 0.001). Comparisons of ADHD treatments indicate that pharmacotherapy can reduce attention deficit severity and increase correct responses in children with ADHD.

text: We prospectively evaluated the efficacy of dissolution therapy and standard shock wave lithotripsy as a noninvasive modality for radiolucent renal stones in children . A total of 87 children with radiolucent renal calculi were included in study . Median age was 2.5 years ( range 0.5 to 13 ) . Computerized tomography was done to confirm a stone density of less than 500 HU . Median stone length was 12 mm ( range 7 to 24 ) . Patients were randomly divided into 2 groups . The medical group of 48 patients received potassium sodium hydrogen citrate at a dose of 1 mEq/kg per day for 1 to 3 months . The shock wave lithotripsy group of 39 patients were treated with a Lithotripter S ( Dornier Medtech , Kennesaw , Georgia ) while under general anesthesia . Complications in each group were recorded . Patients were considered stone free when imaging within 3 months showed no evidence of stones . The stone-free rate was 72.9 % for dissolution therapy vs 82.1 % after a single session of shock wave lithotripsy ( p = 0.314 ) . One patient per group experienced a pyelonephritis episode during followup ( p = 0.698 ) . Three of the 13 patients in whom medical regimens failed were noncompliant and 5 ingested the medication sporadically . Medical dissolution therapy is a well tolerated , effective treatment for radiolucent renal stones in children . It eliminates the need for shock wave lithotripsy in up to 73 % of cases .
rewrite: We prospectively assessed the effectiveness of dissolution therapy and conventional shock wave lithotripsy as noninvasive treatments for radiolucent kidney stones in pediatric patients. The study enrolled 87 children with radiolucent renal stones. The median age was 2.5 years (range 0.5–13). Computed tomography confirmed stone densities below 500 HU. Median stone length measured 12 mm (range 7–24). Participants were randomly assigned to two groups. The medical group, comprising 48 patients, received potassium sodium hydrogen citrate at 1 mEq/kg daily for 1–3 months. The shock wave lithotripsy group, with 39 patients, underwent treatment using a Lithotripter S (Dornier Medtech, Kennesaw, Georgia) under general anesthesia. Complications in both groups were documented. Patients were deemed stone-free if imaging within three months revealed no residual stones. The stone-free rate was 72.9% for dissolution therapy compared to 82.1% after a single shock wave lithotripsy session (p = 0.314). One patient per group developed pyelonephritis during follow-up (p = 0.698). Among the 13 patients for whom medical therapy failed, three were noncompliant and five took medication irregularly. Medical dissolution therapy is a well-tolerated and effective option for radiolucent renal stones in children, potentially avoiding shock wave lithotripsy in approximately 73% of cases.

text: Several studies suggest that most school-age children are poorly informed about cancer risk factors . This study examines the effectiveness of the ` Be smart against cancer ' ( BSAC ) program in promoting cancer awareness and intentions to engage in health-promoting behavior . 235 seventh-grade students were randomized to either the intervention ( N = 152 ) or the wait-control group ( N = 83 ) . The intervention included the modules : `` What is cancer ? , '' `` Sun protection , '' `` Non smoking , '' and `` Physical activity , Healthy nutrition , and Limited alcohol consumption . '' Outcomes measured at baseline and at the end of the one week BSAC program included knowledge of cancer and its behavioral risk factors , health-promoting intentions , and reported risk behavior . BSAC was effective in increasing knowledge about cancer and risk factors for cancer ( p < .001 ) , as well as in increasing intentions to engage in health-promoting behavior ( p < .001 ) , independent of a student 's risk profile . Knowledge did not serve as a mediator for intention building . The BSAC is an effective school-based program for raising awareness of cancer , associated risk factors and intentions to engage in cancer-preventive behavior . The results indicate that the effectiveness of BSAC is independent of a student 's risk profile . Therefore , it holds considerable promise as a broadly applicable program to raise cancer awareness and promote healthy behavior intentions .
rewrite: Research indicates that many school-aged children lack adequate knowledge about cancer risk factors. This investigation assesses the impact of the "Be smart against cancer" (BSAC) initiative on enhancing cancer awareness and fostering intentions for health-promoting actions. A total of 235 seventh-grade students were randomly assigned to either the intervention group (N = 152) or a wait-control group (N = 83). The intervention comprised modules titled: "What is cancer?," "Sun protection," "Non smoking," and "Physical activity, Healthy nutrition, and Limited alcohol consumption." Measurements taken at baseline and after the one-week BSAC program covered cancer knowledge, awareness of behavioral risk factors, health-promoting intentions, and reported risk behaviors. BSAC significantly improved knowledge about cancer and its risk factors (p < .001) and strengthened intentions to adopt health-promoting behaviors (p < .001), regardless of a student's risk profile. Knowledge did not act as a mediator for forming intentions. BSAC proves to be an effective school-based program for increasing awareness of cancer, its related risk factors, and intentions to engage in cancer-preventive behaviors. The findings show that BSAC's effectiveness is not influenced by a student's risk profile, highlighting its potential as a widely applicable program to boost cancer awareness and encourage healthy behavioral intentions.

text: To study the application value of asthma predictive index ( API ) - based group therapy in wheezing children under 5 years of age . A total of 239 wheezing children under 5 years of age were divided into API-positive ( n = 126 ) and API-negative groups ( n = 113 ) . Each group was randomly assigned to inhaled corticosteroids ( ICS ) subgroup and montelukast sodium ( leukotriene receptor antagonist , LTRA ) subgroup . The ICS and LTRA subgroups received the same drug therapy at the same dosage within the first four weeks of treatment . In the stable period of disease , the ICS subgroup only received aerosol inhalation of budesonide suspension , while the LTRA group was orally given montelukast sodium only . Asthma symptom scores were assessed and recorded at different time points . In the first four weeks of treatment , ICS and LTRA were effective both in the API-positive and API-negative groups ; the two groups showed significant improvements in asthma symptom scores , and the asthma symptom score showed no significant difference between the ICS and LTRA subgroups of each group . After 24 weeks of treatment , the two therapies were still effective ; in the API-positive group , the LTRA subgroup had a better treatment outcome than the ICS subgroup , but there was no significant difference in treatment outcome between the LTRA and ICS subgroups of the API-negative group . For wheezing children under 5 years of age , therapeutic strategies can be chosen based on API in the stable period of disease , so as to better control wheezing .
rewrite: To investigate the clinical utility of asthma predictive index (API)-guided treatment in children under five years with wheezing. A cohort of 239 wheezing children under five was categorized into API-positive (n=126) and API-negative groups (n=113). Each group was further randomized into inhaled corticosteroids (ICS) and montelukast sodium (leukotriene receptor antagonist, LTRA) subgroups. During the initial four weeks, both ICS and LTRA subgroups received identical drug regimens at equivalent dosages. In the stable phase, the ICS subgroup continued with budesonide suspension via aerosol inhalation, while the LTRA subgroup received oral montelukast sodium alone. Asthma symptom scores were evaluated and documented at various intervals. In the first four weeks, ICS and LTRA demonstrated efficacy in both API-positive and API-negative groups, with significant reductions in symptom scores and no notable differences between the ICS and LTRA subgroups within each group. After 24 weeks, both treatments remained effective; in the API-positive group, the LTRA subgroup achieved superior outcomes compared to the ICS subgroup, whereas no significant difference was observed between the LTRA and ICS subgroups in the API-negative group. For wheezing children under five, treatment approaches may be selected according to API status during the stable period to enhance wheezing control.

text: Bleeding after haemorrhoidectomy is common . Many surgical textbooks recommend insertion of an anal tampon in order to reduce postoperative bleeding . This practice , however , is bothersome and probably painful for patients . The effect of using a tamponade has not been validated in randomised controlled trials . The study included 100 patients who were scheduled for Milligan-Morgan haemorrhoidectomy . During surgery , patients were randomly assigned to receive or not to receive an anal tampon at the end of the procedure . Data on pain , complications and wound care were collected . The trial was registered ( DRKS00003116 ) and all analyses were by intention-to-treat . There were 48 patients in the group with tamponade , and 52 patients were left without tamponade . The trial 's primary outcome and maximum pain intensity , averaged 6.1 and 4.2 in the two groups ( P = 0.001 ) . In the group with tamponade , a complication was recorded in seven patients ( 15 % ) , which was similar to the group without tamponade ( 21 % ) . Severe anal bleeding occurred in two and five patients , respectively . Bandage changes were less necessary often in the group treated without tamponade ( P = 0.013 ) . Hospital stay was 4 days in both groups . Data indicate that insertion of an anal tampon after haemorrhoidectomy does not reduce postoperative bleeding but causes significantly more pain . After haemorrhoidectomy , anal tampons should not be used routinely but may be considered when specific indications justify its use .
rewrite: Postoperative bleeding is frequent following haemorrhoidectomy. Numerous surgical texts advise placing an anal tampon to minimise such bleeding. However, this approach is uncomfortable and likely painful for patients. The efficacy of tamponade has not been confirmed through randomised controlled trials. This study enrolled 100 patients scheduled for Milligan-Morgan haemorrhoidectomy. Intraoperatively, patients were randomly allocated to receive or not receive an anal tampon upon completion. Information on pain, complications, and wound management was gathered. The trial was registered (DRKS00003116), and all analyses followed intention-to-treat principles. The tamponade group comprised 48 patients, while 52 patients had no tamponade. The primary outcome, maximum pain intensity, averaged 6.1 and 4.2 in the two groups (P=0.001). Complications were noted in seven patients (15%) with tamponade, comparable to the group without (21%). Severe anal bleeding affected two and five patients, respectively. Bandage changes were less frequently required in the non-tamponade group (P=0.013). Hospital stay was 4 days for both groups. Findings suggest that anal tampon insertion after haemorrhoidectomy does not decrease postoperative bleeding but results in notably greater pain. Anal tampons should not be standard practice after haemorrhoidectomy but might be reserved for specific, justified indications.

text: We assessed whether a brief alcohol intervention would lead to reduced alcohol use and sexually transmitted infection ( STI ) / HIV incidence and related sexual risk behaviors among moderate drinking female sex workers . A randomized controlled intervention trial was conducted with 818 female sex workers affiliated with the AIDS , Population , Health , and Integrated Assistance II project in Mombasa , Kenya . Eligible women were hazardous or harmful drinkers who scored between 7 and 19 ( full range , 1-40 ) on the Alcohol Use Disorders Identification Test . Intervention participants received 6 counseling sessions approximately monthly . The equal-attention control group received 6 nutrition sessions . Participants were followed for 6 and 12 months after the intervention , with at least 86 % retention at both time points . We used general linear models in intention-to-treat analyses , adjusting for recruitment setting and HIV status at enrollment . There was a statistically significant reduction in alcohol use and binge drinking at 6 and 12 months , with intervention participants reporting less than one third of the odds of higher levels of drinking than the control group . The intervention did not impact laboratory-confirmed STI/HIV incidence , self-reported condom use , or sexual violence from nonpaying partners . However , the odds of reporting sexual violence from clients was significantly lower among intervention than control participants at both 6 and 12 months . We found that a brief alcohol intervention can reduce self-reported alcohol consumption among a nondependent and non-treatment-seeking population most at risk for HIV . More attention is needed to understand the pathway from drinking to sexual behavior and STI/HIV acquisition .
rewrite: We evaluated if a short alcohol intervention could decrease alcohol consumption and sexually transmitted infection (STI)/HIV incidence along with associated sexual risk behaviors among moderate-drinking female sex workers. A randomized controlled trial involved 818 female sex workers from the AIDS, Population, Health, and Integrated Assistance II project in Mombasa, Kenya. Eligible participants were hazardous or harmful drinkers scoring 7 to 19 (full range 1-40) on the Alcohol Use Disorders Identification Test. The intervention group received six monthly counseling sessions, while the equal-attention control group had six nutrition sessions. Follow-ups occurred at 6 and 12 months post-intervention, with retention rates exceeding 86% at both intervals. Using general linear models in intention-to-treat analyses, adjusted for recruitment setting and baseline HIV status, we observed statistically significant declines in alcohol use and binge drinking at 6 and 12 months. Intervention participants showed less than one-third the odds of higher drinking levels compared to controls. The intervention did not affect laboratory-confirmed STI/HIV incidence, self-reported condom use, or sexual violence from nonpaying partners. However, the odds of reporting sexual violence from clients were significantly lower in the intervention group at both follow-ups. Our findings indicate that a brief alcohol intervention can reduce self-reported alcohol use in a nondependent, non-treatment-seeking population at high HIV risk. Further research is needed to clarify the link between drinking, sexual behavior, and STI/HIV acquisition.

text: To examine whether mindfulness-based cognitive therapy ( MBCT ) would enhance attenuated amplitudes of event-related potentials ( ERPs ) indexing performance monitoring biomarkers of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder ( ADHD ) . Fifty adult ADHD patients took part in a randomised controlled study investigating ERP and clinical measures pre-to-post MBCT . Twenty-six patients were randomly allocated to MBCT , 24 to a wait-list control . Main outcome measures included error processing ( ERN , Pe ) , conflict monitoring ( NoGo-N2 ) , and inhibitory control ( NoGo-P3 ) ERPs concomitant to a continuous performance task ( CPT-X ) . Inattention and hyperactivity-impulsivity ADHD symptoms , psychological distress and social functioning , and mindfulness skills were also assessed . MBCT was associated with increased Pe and NoGo-P3 amplitudes , coinciding with reduced ` hyperactivity/impulsivity ' and ` inattention ' symptomatology . Specific to the MBCT ; enhanced Pe amplitudes correlated with a decrease in hyperactivity/impulsivity symptoms and increased ` act-with-awareness ' mindfulness skill , whereas , enhanced P3 correlated with amelioration in inattention symptoms . MBCT enhanced ERP amplitudes associated with motivational saliency and error awareness , leading to improved inhibitory regulation . MBCT suggests having comparable modulation on performance monitoring ERP amplitudes as pharmacological treatments . Further study and development of MBCT as a treatment for ADHD is warranted , in addition to its potential scope for clinical applicability to broader defined externalising disorders and clinical problems associated with impairments of the prefrontal cortex .
rewrite: To investigate if mindfulness-based cognitive therapy (MBCT) could improve reduced event-related potential (ERP) amplitudes linked to performance monitoring biomarkers in attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). In a randomized controlled trial, fifty adult ADHD patients underwent ERP and clinical assessments before and after MBCT. Twenty-six patients were assigned to MBCT, while twenty-four served as wait-list controls. Primary outcomes focused on error processing (ERN, Pe), conflict monitoring (NoGo-N2), and inhibitory control (NoGo-P3) ERPs during a continuous performance task (CPT-X). ADHD symptoms of inattention and hyperactivity-impulsivity, psychological distress, social functioning, and mindfulness skills were also evaluated. MBCT led to heightened Pe and NoGo-P3 amplitudes, alongside decreased hyperactivity/impulsivity and inattention symptoms. Specifically for MBCT, increased Pe amplitudes were linked to reduced hyperactivity/impulsivity and greater 'act-with-awareness' mindfulness, while enhanced P3 correlated with better inattention. MBCT boosted ERP amplitudes related to motivational salience and error awareness, resulting in enhanced inhibitory regulation. MBCT appears to modulate performance monitoring ERP amplitudes similarly to pharmacological interventions. Further research and refinement of MBCT for ADHD treatment are needed, considering its potential application to broader externalizing disorders and clinical issues involving prefrontal cortex impairments.

text: A constructive safety culture is essential for the successful implementation of patient safety improvements . To assess the effect of two patient safety culture interventions on incident reporting as a proxy of safety culture . A three-arm cluster randomised trial was conducted in a mixed method study , studying the effect of administering a patient safety culture questionnaire ( intervention I ) , the questionnaire complemented with a practice-based workshop ( intervention II ) and no intervention ( control ) in 30 general practices in the Netherlands . The primary outcome , the number of reported incidents , was measured with a questionnaire at baseline and a year after . Analysis was performed using a negative binomial model . Secondary outcomes were quality and safety indicators and safety culture . Mixed effects linear regression was used to analyse the culture questionnaires . The number of incidents increased in both intervention groups , to 82 and 224 in intervention I and II respectively . Adjusted for baseline number of incidents , practice size and accreditation status , the study showed that practices that additionally participated in the workshop reported 42 ( 95 % confidence interval [ CI ] = 9.81 to 177.50 ) times more incidents compared to the control group . Practices that only completed the questionnaire reported 5 ( 95 % CI = 1.17 to 25.49 ) times more incidents . There were no statistically significant differences in staff perception of patient safety culture at follow-up between the three study groups . Educating staff and facilitating discussion about patient safety culture in their own practice leads to increased reporting of incidents . It is beneficial to invest in a team-wise effort to improve patient safety .
rewrite: A strong safety culture is crucial for effectively implementing patient safety improvements. This study evaluated the impact of two safety culture interventions on incident reporting as an indicator of safety culture. A three-arm cluster randomized trial was conducted using mixed methods, examining the effects of administering a patient safety culture questionnaire (intervention I), the questionnaire combined with a practice-based workshop (intervention II), and no intervention (control) across 30 general practices in the Netherlands. The primary outcome, the number of reported incidents, was assessed via questionnaire at baseline and one year later. Analysis employed a negative binomial model. Secondary outcomes included quality and safety indicators and safety culture. Mixed effects linear regression was used to analyze the culture questionnaires. Incident numbers rose in both intervention groups, reaching 82 and 224 in interventions I and II, respectively. After adjusting for baseline incident counts, practice size, and accreditation status, practices that also took part in the workshop reported 42 (95% CI = 9.81 to 177.50) times more incidents compared to the control group. Practices that only completed the questionnaire reported 5 (95% CI = 1.17 to 25.49) times more incidents. No statistically significant differences in staff perceptions of patient safety culture were observed at follow-up among the three groups. Educating staff and encouraging discussions about patient safety within their practice enhances incident reporting. Investing in team-based efforts to improve patient safety is advantageous.

text: To study whether Johan Sebastian Bach music has a lowering effect on resting energy expenditure ( REE ) similar to that of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart music . Prospective , randomized clinical trial with cross-over in 12 healthy , appropriate weights for gestational age ( GA ) , gavage fed , metabolically stable , preterm infants . Infants were randomized to a 30-min period of either Mozart or Bach music or no music over 3 consecutive days . REE was measured every minute by indirect calorimetry . Three REE measurements were performed in each of 12 infants at age 2015.8 days . Mean GA was 30.172.44 weeks and mean birthweight was 1246239g . REE was similar during the first 10-min of all three randomization periods . During the next 10-min period , infants exposed to music by Mozart had a trend toward lower REE than when not exposed to music . This trend became significant during the third 10-min period . In contrast , music by Bach or no music did not affect significantly REE during the whole study . On average , the effect size of Mozart music upon REE was a reduction of 7.7 % from baseline . Mozart music significantly lowers REE in preterm infants , whereas Bach music has no similar effect . We speculate that ` Mozart effect ' must be taken into account when incorporating music in the therapy of preterm infants , as not all types of music may have similar effects upon REE and growth .
rewrite: To investigate if Johann Sebastian Bach's music reduces resting energy expenditure (REE) similarly to Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's music. A prospective, randomized crossover trial involved 12 healthy, appropriately grown, gavage-fed, metabolically stable preterm infants. Over three days, infants were randomly assigned to 30-minute sessions of Mozart, Bach, or no music. REE was monitored per minute via indirect calorimetry. Each infant underwent three REE assessments at 2015.8 days old. Average gestational age was 30.17±2.44 weeks, with a mean birthweight of 1246±239g. REE remained comparable across all groups in the initial 10 minutes. In the following 10 minutes, infants listening to Mozart showed a tendency toward reduced REE compared to no music. This reduction became significant in the final 10-minute interval. Conversely, Bach's music or silence did not notably influence REE throughout the study. On average, Mozart's music decreased REE by 7.7% from baseline. Mozart's music significantly lowers REE in preterm infants, while Bach's does not produce a comparable effect. We suggest that the 'Mozart effect' should be considered when using music in preterm infant therapy, as different music types may vary in their impact on REE and growth.

text: To evaluate the relationship between spectral-domain optical coherence tomography ( OCT ) and standard automated perimetry ( SAP ) in healthy and glaucoma individuals . The sample comprised 338 individuals divided into 2 groups according to intraocular pressure and visual field outcomes . All participants underwent a reliable SAP and imaging of the optic nerve head with the Cirrus OCT. . Pearson correlations were calculated between threshold sensitivity values of SAP ( converted to linear scale ) and OCT parameters . Mean age did not differ between the control and glaucoma groups ( 59.55 9.7 years and 61.05 9.4 years , resp. ; P = 0.15 ) . Significant differences were found for the threshold sensitivities at each of the 52 points evaluated with SAP ( P < 0.001 ) and the peripapillary retinal nerve fiber layer ( RNFL ) thicknesses , except at 3 and 9 clock-hour positions between both groups . Mild to moderate correlations ( ranging between 0.286 and 0.593 ; P < 0.001 ) were observed between SAP and most OCT parameters in the glaucoma group . The strongest correlations were found between the inferior RNFL thickness and the superior hemifield points . The healthy group showed lower and weaker correlations than the glaucoma group . Peripapillary RNFL thickness measured with Cirrus OCT showed mild to moderate correlations with SAP in glaucoma patients .
rewrite: This study assessed the relationship between spectral-domain optical coherence tomography (OCT) and standard automated perimetry (SAP) in healthy and glaucomatous eyes. A sample of 338 participants was categorized into two groups based on intraocular pressure and visual field results. All subjects completed reliable SAP testing and optic nerve head imaging using Cirrus OCT. Pearson correlations were computed between SAP threshold sensitivity values (converted to a linear scale) and OCT parameters. Mean age was similar between the control and glaucoma groups (59.55 ± 9.7 years and 61.05 ± 9.4 years, respectively; P = 0.15). Significant differences were detected for SAP threshold sensitivities at all 52 tested points (P < 0.001) and for peripapillary retinal nerve fiber layer (RNFL) thicknesses, except at the 3 and 9 o'clock positions between groups. In the glaucoma group, mild to moderate correlations (ranging from 0.286 to 0.593; P < 0.001) were found between SAP and most OCT parameters. The strongest correlations were between inferior RNFL thickness and superior hemifield points. The healthy group exhibited lower and weaker correlations compared to the glaucoma group. Peripapillary RNFL thickness measured with Cirrus OCT demonstrated mild to moderate correlations with SAP in glaucoma patients.

text: Patients with type 2 diabetes ( T2D ) are prone to develop preclinical myocardial dysfunction , but no single strategy to prevent progression to heart failure has been established . We aimed to assess whether intensified global cardiovascular ( CV ) risk factor control would improve left ventricular ( LV ) systolic and diastolic function as compared with standard of care . A total of 100 patients with 1 CV risk factor ( 29 % female , mean SD age 58 10 years , LV ejection fraction 63 8 % , 16 % with LV diastolic dysfunction ) were randomized to 2 years of intensified CV risk multi-intervention ( INT , n = 50 ) or standard care ( STAND , n = 50 ) . Echocardiography , including tissue Doppler imaging , and maximum exercise test were performed at baseline and study end . Multi-intervention comprised lifestyle intervention and pharmacologic treatment to reach strict prespecified CV risk factor goals , whereas STAND group received current guideline care . Greater reductions were observed for hemoglobin A1c and total cholesterol in the INT group ( P < .001 and P = .021 , respectively ) , whereas blood pressure reduction was similar . Work capacity increased in INT and decreased in STAND ( P = .014 ) . There was no significant between-group difference in the change in any of the echocardiographic parameters . Two years of intensified multi-intervention in patients with T2D improved work capacity and glycemic and lipid control and had no significant benefit or harm on resting cardiac function .
rewrite: Individuals with type 2 diabetes (T2D) often experience early myocardial dysfunction, yet no definitive approach to avert heart failure progression exists. This study evaluated whether enhanced comprehensive cardiovascular (CV) risk management could better left ventricular (LV) systolic and diastolic function versus standard care. One hundred patients having at least one CV risk factor (29% female, mean age 58±10 years, LV ejection fraction 63±8%, 16% with LV diastolic dysfunction) were randomly assigned to two years of intensified multi-factorial CV risk intervention (INT, n=50) or standard care (STAND, n=50). Echocardiography with tissue Doppler and maximal exercise testing were conducted at start and finish. The INT regimen combined lifestyle modification and medication to achieve stringent predefined CV risk targets, while the STAND group received guideline-based care. The INT group showed larger decreases in hemoglobin A1c and total cholesterol (P<.001 and P=.021, respectively), though blood pressure reduction was comparable. Work capacity rose in INT but fell in STAND (P=.014). No significant intergroup differences emerged in changes to echocardiographic measures. In T2D patients, two years of intensified multi-intervention enhanced work capacity and glucose and lipid regulation, without markedly affecting resting cardiac function positively or negatively.

text: Pain at the surgery site is a common complaint in patients who experience percutaneous nephrolithotomy ( PCNL ) . The aim of this double-blind , randomized clinical trial is evaluation of the effect of scheduled infusion of bupivacaine on postsurgical pain and narcotic consumption after tubeless PCNL under spinal anesthesia . Forty patients were randomly divided into two groups . A small caliber fenestrated feeding tube was placed into the nephrostomy tract under direct vision in a manner in which its tip lied close to the renal capsule . The study group received infusion of diluted bupivacaine while physiologic saline was injected in the control group . Each patient was given the same dose every 6 hours until 24 hours after the surgical procedure . Mean pethidine injection was significantly lower in the group who underwent bupivacaine instillation ( 20.514.5 vs 3.972.4 mg : P = 0.009 ) . There was no significant difference between mean visual analogue scale ( VAS ) score in these two groups after 6 and 12 hours while it was significantly lower after 18 and 24 hours in the patients who had received bupivacaine . Mean time to the first analgesic request was significantly longer in the study group ( 11.35 vs 6.44 hours : P = 0.001 ) . Intermittent perirenal instillation of bupivacaine via the nephrostomy tract after PCNL decreases the need for more systemic narcotics and provides acceptable analgesia in the postoperative period .
rewrite: Postoperative pain at the surgical site is frequently reported by patients undergoing percutaneous nephrolithotomy (PCNL). This double-blind, randomized clinical trial assesses the impact of scheduled bupivacaine infusion on postsurgical pain and opioid use following tubeless PCNL under spinal anesthesia. Forty participants were randomly assigned to two groups. A narrow fenestrated feeding tube was positioned in the nephrostomy tract under direct vision, with its tip near the renal capsule. The study group received diluted bupivacaine infusion, whereas the control group was given physiologic saline. Each patient received the same dosage every six hours for 24 hours post-surgery. Mean pethidine use was notably reduced in the bupivacaine group (20.5±14.5 vs. 3.9±2.4 mg; P=0.009). No significant difference in mean visual analogue scale (VAS) scores was observed between groups at 6 and 12 hours, but scores were significantly lower at 18 and 24 hours in the bupivacaine recipients. The mean time to first analgesic request was significantly longer in the study group (11.35 vs. 6.44 hours; P=0.001). Intermittent perirenal bupivacaine instillation via the nephrostomy tract after PCNL reduces systemic narcotic requirements and offers satisfactory postoperative analgesia.

text: Seroma formation is the most frequent postoperative complication after axillary dissection for breast surgery with an incidence of 10 - 50 % . This prospective clinical randomized study was carried out to evaluate the Ligasure vessel sealing system and its effect on seromaformation and other complications for axillary dissection . Between January 2006 and November 2007 , the patients with histopathological diagnosis of breast cancer were analysed prospectively . The patients with positive sentinel lymph node biopsy or clinical axillary involvement were included in the study , and the patients who underwent neoadjuvant therapy or using anticoagulants have been excluded from the study . Patients were divided into two study groups.Axillary dissection was performed in the first group by LigaSure and in the second group by linking and electrocautery . There were a total of thirty three patients with a mean age of 51.4 + - 13.7 . In group one , mean age of patients was 54.1 + - 13.2 and 48.68 + - 14.1 in group two . There was no significant statistical difference between the groups regarding age , body mass index , excised tissue weight , tumour size and number of excised lymph nodes . The use of Ligasure reduced drainage amount and duration of drain till removal , but increased operative time . There were no significant differences between study groups regarding the complications . LigaSure electrothermal bipolar vessel sealing system can be safely used in axillary dissection as an alternative to traditional methods .
rewrite: Seroma formation represents the most common postoperative complication following axillary dissection in breast surgery, occurring in 10–50% of cases. This prospective randomized clinical study aimed to assess the LigaSure vessel sealing system and its impact on seroma formation and other complications during axillary dissection. From January 2006 to November 2007, patients with a histopathological diagnosis of breast cancer were prospectively analyzed. Those with positive sentinel lymph node biopsy or clinical axillary involvement were included, while patients receiving neoadjuvant therapy or anticoagulants were excluded. Participants were divided into two groups: axillary dissection was performed using LigaSure in the first group and with ligation and electrocautery in the second. The study comprised 33 patients with a mean age of 51.4 ± 13.7 years. In group one, the mean age was 54.1 ± 13.2, and in group two, it was 48.68 ± 14.1. No significant statistical differences were observed between groups regarding age, body mass index, excised tissue weight, tumor size, or number of excised lymph nodes. The use of LigaSure reduced drainage volume and duration until drain removal but increased operative time. No significant differences in complications were found between the groups. The LigaSure electrothermal bipolar vessel sealing system can be safely employed in axillary dissection as an alternative to conventional methods.

text: The goal of this study was to analyze the differences in ultrasound characteristics of papillary thyroid carcinoma ( PTC ) originating in the thyroid isthmus versus that originating from the lobes . From a retrospective review of our institution 's database of records dated between January 2007 and December 2008 , we identified 48 patients with classic PTCs located in the isthmus . All the patients had undergone preoperative ultrasound imaging , total thyroidectomy with bilateral central lymph node dissection , and postoperative follow-up for at least 2 years . As a control group , 96 patients with classic PTCs located in the lobe who had undergone total thyroidectomy with bilateral central lymph node dissection during the same period were randomly matched to the study patients for age , sex , and tumor size . According to the clinicopathologic analyses , the incidence of extrathyroidal extension was higher in the patients with a tumor originating in the isthmus than in the control group ( p = 0.026 ) . According to the imaging analyses , the tumors originating in the isthmus more frequently had a circumscribed margin ( p = 0.030 ) , a wider-than-tall shape ( p < 0.001 ) , and the suspicion of extrathyroidal extension ( p < 0.001 ) than those originating from the lobes . The results of this study showed that PTCs originating in the isthmus were more likely to have extrathyroidal extension than those originating from the lobes . Therefore , careful ultrasound evaluation should be performed on masses in the thyroid isthmus even if ultrasound shows a circumscribed mass with a wider-than-tall shape .
rewrite: This study aimed to compare the ultrasound features of papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC) arising in the thyroid isthmus versus the lobes. Through a retrospective review of our institution's database from January 2007 to December 2008, we identified 48 patients with classic PTCs situated in the isthmus. All patients had preoperative ultrasound, total thyroidectomy with bilateral central lymph node dissection, and at least two years of postoperative follow-up. For comparison, 96 patients with classic PTCs in the lobe, who underwent the same surgical procedure during the same period, were randomly matched by age, sex, and tumor size. Clinicopathologic analysis revealed a higher incidence of extrathyroidal extension in patients with isthmus-originating tumors compared to the control group (p = 0.026). Imaging analysis indicated that tumors originating in the isthmus more often exhibited a circumscribed margin (p = 0.030), a wider-than-tall shape (p < 0.001), and suspected extrathyroidal extension (p < 0.001) than those from the lobes. The findings demonstrate that PTCs originating in the isthmus are more prone to extrathyroidal extension than those from the lobes. Consequently, careful ultrasound assessment is warranted for thyroid isthmus masses, even when imaging reveals a circumscribed, wider-than-tall lesion.

text: To evaluate whether couples with moderate male infertility should be treated with conventional in vitro fertilization ( IVF ) or intracytoplasmic sperm injection ( ICSI ) . A total of 249 couples with moderate male infertility undergoing their first IVF/ICSI cycle were enrolled in the study . The couples were divided into two groups according to the results of semen analysis : moderate oligozoospermia ( O group ) and moderate oligoasthenozoospermia ( OA group ) .
