Strong TAZ protein expression appears connected to rectal cancer progression and RT response, potentially serving as a predictive biomarker for distant recurrence in patients undergoing preoperative RT.

text: Video games have become popular in stroke rehabilitation ; however , the nature of this intervention is not fully understood . To compare the number of ( a ) purposeful and nonpurposeful repetitions of the weaker upper extremity ( UE ) and ( b ) movement accelerations as assessed by accelerometer activity counts of the weaker and stronger UEs of individuals with chronic stroke while playing video games or participating in traditional therapy . Twenty-nine individuals ( mean age 59 years , 1-7 years poststroke ) took part in a group intervention of video - games ( n = 15 ) or traditional therapy ( n = 14 ) as part of a randomized controlled trial . During 1-2 sessions , participants were video-taped while wearing wrist accelerometers . Assessors counted the number of repetitions and classified movements as purposeful or nonpurposeful using videotapes . The weaker UE motor impairments were correlated to movement accelerations , to determine if participants were using their potential during the sessions . Participants in the video game group performed a median of 271 purposeful movements and 37 970 activity counts compared to 48 purposeful movements and 14,872 activity counts in the traditional group ( z = -3.0 , P = .001 and z = -1.9 , P = .05 , respectively ) . Participants in the traditional group performed a median of 26 nonpurposeful ( exercises ) compared with 0 in the video game group ( z = -4.2 , P = .000 ) . Strong significant correlations were found between the motor ability of the weak UE to repetitions of participants in both groups ( r = .86 , P < .01 ) . Participants with higher motor ability performed more repetitions . Video games elicited more UE purposeful repetitions and higher acceleration of movement compared with traditional therapy in individuals with chronic stroke .
rewrite: Video games are increasingly used in stroke rehabilitation, yet the specifics of this approach remain unclear. This study compared (a) purposeful versus nonpurposeful repetitions of the weaker upper extremity (UE) and (b) movement accelerations measured by accelerometer counts for both weaker and stronger UEs in chronic stroke patients during video game play versus traditional therapy. Twenty-nine participants (mean age 59, 1–7 years poststroke) were assigned to a video game group (n=15) or a traditional therapy group (n=14) in a randomized controlled trial. Over 1–2 sessions, they were videotaped while wearing wrist accelerometers. Assessors reviewed recordings to count repetitions and categorize movements as purposeful or nonpurposeful. Weaker UE motor impairment was correlated with movement acceleration to assess whether participants used their full capacity. The video game group showed medians of 271 purposeful movements and 37,970 activity counts, versus 48 purposeful movements and 14,872 counts in the traditional group (z=-3.0, P=.001 and z=-1.9, P=.05, respectively). The traditional group performed a median of 26 nonpurposeful movements, compared to 0 in the video game group (z=-4.2, P=.000). Strong correlations were found between weaker UE motor ability and repetitions in both groups (r=.86, P<.01), with higher ability linked to more repetitions. Video games produced more purposeful UE repetitions and greater movement acceleration than traditional therapy in chronic stroke patients.

text: Patients with heart failure ( HF ) who live in rural areas have less access to cardiac services than patients in urban areas . We conducted a randomized , clinical trial to determine the impact of an educational intervention on the composite end point of HF rehospitalization and cardiac death in this population . Patients ( n = 602 ; age , 6613 years ; 41 % female ; 51 % with systolic HF ) were randomized to 1 of 3 groups : control ( usual care ) , Fluid Watchers LITE , or Fluid Watchers PLUS . Both intervention groups included a face-to-face education session delivered by a nurse focusing on self-care . The LITE group received 2 follow-up phone calls , whereas the PLUS group received biweekly calls ( mean , 5.33.6 ; range , 1-19 ) until the nurse judged the patient to be adequately trained . Over 2 years of follow-up , 35 % of patients ( n = 211 ) experienced cardiac death or hospitalization for HF , with no difference among the 3 groups in the proportion who experienced the combined clinical outcome ( P = 0.06 ) . Although patients in the LITE group had reduced cardiac mortality compared with patients in the control group over the 2 years of follow-up ( 7.5 % and 17.7 % , respectively ; P = 0.003 ) , there was no significant difference in cardiac mortality between patients in the PLUS group and the control group . A face-to-face education intervention did not significantly decrease the combined end point of cardiac death or hospitalization for HF . Increasing the number of contacts between the patient and nurse did not significantly improve outcome . http://www.clinicaltrials.gov . Unique identifier : NCT00415545 .
rewrite: Patients with heart failure (HF) residing in rural regions have reduced access to cardiac services compared to those in urban areas. We performed a randomized clinical trial to assess the effect of an educational intervention on the composite outcome of HF rehospitalization and cardiac death in this group. Participants (n = 602; age, 66 ± 13 years; 41% female; 51% with systolic HF) were randomly assigned to one of three groups: control (usual care), Fluid Watchers LITE, or Fluid Watchers PLUS. Both intervention arms involved a nurse-led, in-person education session centered on self-care. The LITE group received two follow-up phone calls, while the PLUS group received calls every two weeks (mean, 5.3 ± 3.6; range, 1–19) until the nurse deemed the patient sufficiently trained. During two years of follow-up, 35% of patients (n = 211) experienced cardiac death or HF hospitalization, with no significant difference across the three groups in the combined clinical outcome (P = 0.06). Although cardiac mortality was lower in the LITE group than in the control group over the follow-up period (7.5% vs. 17.7%; P = 0.003), there was no notable difference in cardiac mortality between the PLUS and control groups. An in-person education intervention did not meaningfully reduce the combined endpoint of cardiac death or HF hospitalization. Increasing patient-nurse contacts did not lead to a significant improvement in outcomes. http://www.clinicaltrials.gov. Unique identifier: NCT00415545.

text: To observe the clinical efficacy of warming Shen , enhancing Yang , invigorating qi , and nourishing blood method ( WSEYIQNBM ) combined artificial cycle therapy in treatment of premature ovarian failure ( POF ) patients of Shen yang deficiency syndrome ( SYDS ) . Totally 96 POF patients of SYDS were randomly assigned to the treatment group and the control group , 48 in each group . Patients in the treatment group were treated with WSEYIQNBM combined artificial cycle therapy , while those in the control group were treated with Western medicine artificial cycle therapy . One month constituted 1 course , a total of 3 courses . The menstruation and main symptoms were observed before and after treatment . Serum levels of follicle stimulating hormone ( FSH ) , luteinizing hormone ( LH ) , and estradiol ( E2 ) were detected before and after treatment . The total effective rate was 85.43 % in the treatment group , higher than that of the control group ( 79.17 % , P < 0.05 ) . Besides , better effect in improving Chinese medical symptoms was obtained in the treatment group ( P < 0.05 ) . POF patients ' serum hormone levels and clinical symptoms could be improved by WSEYIQNBM combined artificial cycle therapy .
rewrite: To evaluate the clinical effectiveness of the warming kidney, strengthening yang, boosting qi, and nourishing blood method (WSEYIQNBM) combined with artificial cycle therapy for treating premature ovarian failure (POF) patients with kidney yang deficiency syndrome (SYDS). A total of 96 SYDS POF patients were randomly divided into a treatment group and a control group, with 48 patients each. The treatment group received WSEYIQNBM plus artificial cycle therapy, while the control group received Western medicine artificial cycle therapy alone. Each course lasted one month, totaling three courses. Menstruation and key symptoms were monitored before and after treatment. Serum levels of follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH), luteinizing hormone (LH), and estradiol (E2) were measured pre- and post-treatment. The total effective rate was 85.43% in the treatment group, surpassing the control group's 79.17% (P < 0.05). Additionally, the treatment group showed superior improvement in traditional Chinese medical symptoms (P < 0.05). WSEYIQNBM combined with artificial cycle therapy can enhance serum hormone levels and alleviate clinical symptoms in POF patients.

text: The optimal agents and duration of primary antifungal prophylaxis in recipients of allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation ( allo-HSCT ) remain a matter of discussion . Our objective was to compare the efficacy and safety of long-term and short-term administration of itraconazole ( ITCZ ) for primary antifungal prophylaxis in allo-HSCT recipients . This multicenter , randomized , open-label pilot study was performed in 4 transplant centers in China . Recipients of allo-HSCT without a history of invasive fungal disease ( IFD ) were randomly assigned to the long-term or the short-term arm . Randomization was carried out by a center computer system . Intravenous ITCZ was given to the patients in both study arms with a loading dose of 400 mg/day for 2 days followed by 200 mg/day until day +14 or when the white blood cell count was > 1.0 10 ( 9 ) / L , and then switched to oral ITCZ solution ; prophylaxis was continued until day +30 post transplantation in the short-term arm or until day +90 in the long-term arm . The trough serum concentrations of ITCZ also were measured . The primary study endpoint was the incidence of IFD ( proven , probable , and possible ) within day +90 post transplantation . A total of 128 recipients were enrolled in this study ; 59 of them were randomized to the long-term arm and 62 were randomized to the short-term arm , forming the modified intent-to-treat ( mITT ) set . The incidence of IFD within day +90 , the primary endpoint , was not significantly different between the 2 arms for the mITT set ( 6.78 % in the long-term arm vs. 6.45 % in the short-term arm , P = 0.94 ) , or for the per-protocol set ( 6.90 % in the long-term arm vs. 6.67 % in the short-term arm , P = 0.96 ) . From day +30 to day +90 , the incidence of IFD was 0 % and 6.45 % , respectively , in the patients with long-term and short-term prophylaxis for the mITT set ( P = 0.11 ) . The mean trough serum concentrations of ITCZ was maintained at > 500 ng/mL throughout administration . The incidences of withdrawal because of drug-related adverse events in patients with long-term and short-term prophylaxis were 6.78 % and 0 % , respectively ( P = 0.05 ) . Long-term and short-term administration of ITCZ both seemed effective in preventing IFD in recipients of allo-HSCT . Further study with large sample size should be performed to evaluate this result . ITCZ shows the same pharmacokinetics in recipients of allo-HSCT as in non-recipients .
rewrite: The ideal agents and duration for primary antifungal prophylaxis in allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (allo-HSCT) recipients continue to be debated. This study aimed to compare the efficacy and safety of prolonged versus brief itraconazole (ITCZ) administration for primary antifungal prophylaxis in allo-HSCT recipients. Conducted as a multicenter, randomized, open-label pilot study across four transplant centers in China, it enrolled allo-HSCT recipients without prior invasive fungal disease (IFD), randomly assigning them to long-term or short-term groups via a central computer system. Both groups received intravenous ITCZ with a 400 mg/day loading dose for two days, then 200 mg/day until day +14 or when white blood cell count exceeded 1.0×10⁹/L, followed by a switch to oral ITCZ solution; prophylaxis ended at day +30 in the short-term group or day +90 in the long-term group. Trough serum ITCZ concentrations were monitored. The primary endpoint was the incidence of IFD (proven, probable, and possible) by day +90 post-transplant. Of 128 enrolled recipients, 59 were assigned to the long-term group and 62 to the short-term group, comprising the modified intent-to-treat (mITT) set. The incidence of IFD by day +90 did not differ significantly between groups in the mITT set (6.78% long-term vs. 6.45% short-term, P=0.94) or per-protocol set (6.90% long-term vs. 6.67% short-term, P=0.96). From day +30 to day +90, IFD incidence was 0% and 6.45% in the long-term and short-term mITT groups, respectively (P=0.11). Mean trough serum ITCZ concentrations remained above 500 ng/mL throughout treatment. Drug-related adverse event withdrawal rates were 6.78% in the long-term group and 0% in the short-term group (P=0.05). Both long-term and short-term ITCZ regimens appeared effective in preventing IFD in allo-HSCT recipients. Larger studies are needed to confirm these findings. ITCZ pharmacokinetics in allo-HSCT recipients were similar to those in non-recipients.

text: To evaluate the effect of calorie restriction-induced weight loss with or without aerobic exercise on liver fat . Thirty-three adults with visceral adiposity were divided into calorie restriction ( CR ; n = 18 ) or CR and aerobic exercise ( CR + Ex ; n = 15 ) groups . Target energy intake was 25kcal/kg of ideal body weight . The CR + Ex group had a targeted exercise time of 300min/wk or more at lactate threshold intensity for 12 weeks . Reductions in body weight ( CR , -5.3 0.8 kg ; CR + Ex , -5.1 0.7 kg ) , fat mass ( CR , -4.9 0.9 kg ; CR + Ex , -4.4 0.6 kg ) , and visceral fat ( CR , -24 5cm2 ; CR + Ex , -37 5cm2 ) were not statistically different between groups . Liver fat decreased significantly in both groups , with no difference between groups . Change in maximal oxygen uptake was significantly greater in the CR + Ex group than in the CR group ( CR , -0.7 0.7 mL/kg/min ; CR + Ex , 2.9 1.0 mL/kg/min ) . Both CR and CR + Ex resulted in an improved reduction in liver fat ; however , there was no additive effect of exercise training .
rewrite: This study assessed how calorie restriction-induced weight loss, with or without aerobic exercise, affects liver fat. Thirty-three adults with visceral adiposity were assigned to either a calorie restriction (CR; n=18) group or a combined calorie restriction and aerobic exercise (CR+Ex; n=15) group. The target energy intake was set at 25 kcal per kg of ideal body weight. The CR+Ex group aimed for at least 300 minutes of weekly exercise at lactate threshold intensity over 12 weeks. Reductions in body weight (CR: -5.3±0.8 kg; CR+Ex: -5.1±0.7 kg), fat mass (CR: -4.9±0.9 kg; CR+Ex: -4.4±0.6 kg), and visceral fat (CR: -24±5 cm²; CR+Ex: -37±5 cm²) did not differ significantly between the groups. Liver fat decreased significantly in both groups, with no significant difference between them. The change in maximal oxygen uptake was significantly greater in the CR+Ex group than in the CR group (CR: -0.7±0.7 mL/kg/min; CR+Ex: 2.9±1.0 mL/kg/min). Both CR and CR+Ex led to a beneficial reduction in liver fat, but exercise training did not provide an additional effect.

text: To compare efficacy differences between fire filiform needle combined with mild moxibustion and gabapentin combined with sham acupuncture for postherpetic neuralgia ( PHN ) . One hundred cases of PHN were randomly divided into a needle group and a medicine group , 50 cases in each one . In the needle group , pricking method of fire filiform needle was given at the Ashi points , and then mild moxibustion was applied for 15 min . In the medicine group , the oral administration of gabapentin capsule and sham acupuncture at non-acupoints in the distal end of lesions were applied . The treatment was required for 21 days in both groups . The visual analogue score ( VAS ) was recorded before treatment and on the 1st day , 2nd day , 3rd day , 6th day , 9th day and 12th day of treatment . The most severity of pain within last 24 h , preset severity of pain , immediate analgesia effect and starting time of pain relief were observed , also the efficacy was assessed and improvement of symptoms was observed in the follow-up visit . The total effective rate was 94.0 % ( 47/50 ) in the fire filiform needle group , which was superior to 86.0 % ( 43/50 ) in the medicine group ( P < 0.05 ) . Compared with medicine group , the VAS of the most severity of pain within last 24 h was obviously reduced after the 2nd treatment in the fire filiform needle group while that of present severity of pain was relieved after the 1st treatment ( both P < 0.05 ) . The immediate analgesia effect in the fire filiform needle group was obviously superior to that in the medicine group in the first three times of treatment ( all P < 0.05 ) . The average time of pain relief was ( 3.91 + / - 0.82 ) days in the fire filiform needle group , which was significantly earlier to ( 6.53 + / - 1.13 ) days in the medicine group ( P < 0.05 ) . 26 cases were cured in the fire filiform needle group in the follow-up visit , which was superior to 2 cases in the medicine group ( P < 0.05 ) . The improvement of VAS , pain range and sleep quality in the needle group were also superior to those in the medicine group ( all P < 0.05 ) . The direct medical cost in the fire filiform needle group was ( 232.32 + / - 48.108 ) yuan , which was significantly lower than ( 466.00 + / - 41.09 ) yuan in the medicine group ( P < 0.05 ) . There was only one case of adverse effect in the medicine group during the treatment . The fire filiform needle combined with mild moxibustion could obviously relieve the pain in PHN patients , which has superior immediate analgesia effect and pain relieving time compared with gabapentin , which also has less adverse effects and cheap cost .
rewrite: To assess the efficacy of fire filiform needle plus mild moxibustion versus gabapentin plus sham acupuncture for postherpetic neuralgia (PHN). One hundred PHN patients were randomly assigned to a needle group and a medicine group, with 50 cases each. The needle group received fire filiform needle pricking at Ashi points, followed by 15 minutes of mild moxibustion. The medicine group took gabapentin capsules orally and received sham acupuncture at non-acupoints distal to the lesions. Both groups were treated for 21 days. Visual analogue scale (VAS) scores were recorded before treatment and on days 1, 2, 3, 6, 9, and 12 of treatment. The worst pain in the last 24 hours, current pain severity, immediate analgesic effect, and onset time of pain relief were observed; efficacy was evaluated and symptom improvement was noted at follow-up. The total effective rate was 94.0% (47/50) in the fire filiform needle group, higher than 86.0% (43/50) in the medicine group (P < 0.05). Compared to the medicine group, VAS for worst pain in the last 24 hours decreased significantly after the second treatment in the needle group, while current pain severity improved after the first treatment (both P < 0.05). Immediate analgesic effect in the needle group was notably better than in the medicine group for the first three treatments (all P < 0.05). Average pain relief time was (3.91 ± 0.82) days in the needle group, significantly earlier than (6.53 ± 1.13) days in the medicine group (P < 0.05). At follow-up, 26 cases were cured in the needle group, compared to 2 in the medicine group (P < 0.05). Improvements in VAS, pain range, and sleep quality were also greater in the needle group (all P < 0.05). Direct medical costs were (232.32 ± 48.108) yuan in the needle group, significantly lower than (466.00 ± 41.09) yuan in the medicine group (P < 0.05). Only one adverse event occurred in the medicine group during treatment. Fire filiform needle combined with mild moxibustion significantly alleviates pain in PHN patients, offering superior immediate analgesia and faster pain relief compared to gabapentin, with fewer adverse effects and lower cost.

text: After the advent of the GreenLight XPS ( 180 W ) 532 nm laser , photoselective vapo-enucleation of the prostate could compete with holmium laser enucleation of the prostate as a size independent procedure . We assessed whether photoselective vapo-enucleation of the prostate-XPS is not less effective than holmium laser enucleation of prostate for improvement of lower urinary tract symptoms secondary to benign prostatic hyperplasia . A randomized controlled noninferiority trial comparing holmium laser enucleation of the prostate to photoselective vapo-enucleation of the prostate-XPS 180 W was conducted . I-PSS , flow rate , residual urine , prostate specific antigen and prostate volume changes as well as perioperative and late adverse events were compared . Noninferiority of I-PSS at 1 year was evaluated using a 1-sided test at 5 % level of significance . The statistical significance of other comparators was assessed at the ( 2-sided ) 5 % level . Overall 50 and 53 patients were included in the holmium laser enucleation and photoselective vapo-enucleation of the prostate groups , respectively . Operative time , hospital stay and time to catheter removal were comparable between the groups . There was significant , comparable improvement in I-PSS and post-void residual urine volume at 1 , 4 and 12 months . After 4 months prostate size reduction was significantly higher in the holmium laser enucleation of prostate group ( 74.3 % vs 43.1 % , p = 0.001 ) . At 12 months maximum urine flow rate was significantly higher in the holmium laser enucleation of prostate group ( 26.4 11.5 vs 18.4 7.5 ml per second , p = 0.03 ) . Re-intervention was needed in 2 and 3 cases in the holmium laser enucleation and photoselective vapo-enucleation of the prostate groups , respectively ( p = 1.0 ) . Mean estimated cost per holmium laser enucleation of prostate procedure was significantly lower than per photoselective vapo-enucleation of the prostate procedure . Compared to holmium laser enucleation of prostate , GreenLight XPS laser photoselective vapo-enucleation of the prostate is safe , noninferior and effective in treatment of benign prostatic hyperplasia .
rewrite: Following the introduction of the GreenLight XPS (180 W) 532 nm laser, photoselective vapo-enucleation of the prostate emerged as a potential rival to holmium laser enucleation of the prostate as a procedure independent of prostate size. text: To compare the change in iris-trabecular contact ( ITC ) area using swept-source optical coherence tomography ( SS-OCT ) in eyes with primary angle closure glaucoma ( PACG ) and cataract that underwent phacoemulsification ( PE ) with intraocular lens implantation alone compared with PE with goniosynechialysis ( GSL ) . One eye of 22 patients with PACG with peripheral anterior synechiae ( PAS ) detected by indentation gonioscopy was randomised into two groups ( PE alone ( n = 11 ) and PE+GSL ( n = 11 ) ) . The anterior chamber angles were evaluated by SS-OCT under dark conditions before and 12months after surgery using the three-dimensional angle analysis scan protocol that simultaneously obtains 128 cross-sectional radial scans across the anterior chamber at equal intervals ( every 1.4 ) . The ITC area , defined as the area of extent of the circumferential contact of peripheral iris to the angle wall , was computed automatically by SS-OCT after an observer marked the scleral spurs of all 128 scans of each eye . The majority of the 22 subjects were women ( 77.3 % ) and the meanSD age was 67.35.8 years . The ITC area was significantly reduced in the PE+GSL group compared with the PE alone group ( 10.2 mm2 vs. 4.6 mm2 , = 0.54 , p = 0.03 ) after adjusting for age , gender , intraocular pressure , extent of PAS and pupil diameter before surgery . Smaller iris volume at baseline was associated with greater ITC area reduction by PE+GSL ( = -0.728 , p = 0.03 ) . Eyes that undergo PE+GSL surgery have a greater reduction in circumferential ITC area than eyes that undergo PE alone .
rewrite: This study compared changes in iris-trabecular contact (ITC) area using swept-source optical coherence tomography (SS-OCT) in primary angle closure glaucoma (PACG) eyes with cataract, undergoing either phacoemulsification (PE) with intraocular lens implantation alone or PE combined with goniosynechialysis (GSL). Twenty-two PACG patients with peripheral anterior synechiae (PAS) confirmed by indentation gonioscopy were randomized into two groups: PE alone (n=11) and PE+GSL (n=11). Anterior chamber angles were assessed by SS-OCT in darkness preoperatively and 12 months postoperatively using a three-dimensional angle analysis protocol, acquiring 128 radial cross-sectional scans at equal intervals (1.4° each). The ITC area, defined as the circumferential contact area between peripheral iris and angle wall, was automatically calculated by SS-OCT after an observer identified scleral spurs in all 128 scans per eye. Most participants were female (77.3%), with a mean age of 67.3±5.8 years. After adjusting for age, gender, preoperative intraocular pressure, PAS extent, and pupil diameter, the ITC area reduction was significantly greater in the PE+GSL group than in the PE alone group (10.2 mm² vs. 4.6 mm², effect size=0.54, p=0.03). A smaller baseline iris volume correlated with greater ITC area reduction following PE+GSL (correlation coefficient=-0.728, p=0.03). Eyes receiving PE+GSL show a more substantial reduction in circumferential ITC area compared to those undergoing PE alone.

text: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of acupuncture for residual insomnia and other residual symptoms associated with major depressive disorder ( MDD ) . 150 participants having significant insomnia for more than 3 months and a history of MDD ( both based on DSM-IV-TR criteria ) were recruited from 4 psychiatric outpatient clinics in Hong Kong from May 2011 to August 2013 to receive 9 sessions of treatment over 3 weeks . They were randomized to receive acupuncture , minimal acupuncture , or placebo acupuncture . Primary outcome was sleep diary-derived sleep efficiency . Secondary outcomes included other sleep diary parameters , actigraphy , anxiety and depressive symptoms , daytime functioning , and adverse events . The mean difference in sleep diary-derived sleep efficiency at 1-week posttreatment was -1.40 ( 95 % CI , -7.08 to 4.28 ) between the acupuncture and minimal acupuncture groups and was 3.10 ( 95 % CI , -3.64 to 9.84 ) between the acupuncture and placebo acupuncture groups . A ( 2 ) test showed that acupuncture produced a significantly higher proportion of participants achieving sleep-onset latency 30 minutes than did minimal acupuncture at 1-week posttreatment ( P = .04 ) . However , there was no significant between-group difference in most of the other outcomes . Treatment blinding was successful , as a majority of participants did not know which treatment they had received . Acupuncture was well tolerated , but the efficacy was only mild and similar to that of minimal acupuncture and placebo acupuncture . A high proportion of patients remained clinically significantly affected by insomnia after treatment . The finding raises certain doubts about the value of acupuncture and underscores the difficulties in the treatment of residual insomnia in MDD . ClinicalTrials.gov identifier : NCT01707706 .
rewrite: To assess the effectiveness and safety of acupuncture for residual insomnia and other remaining symptoms in major depressive disorder (MDD). 150 participants with significant insomnia lasting over 3 months and a history of MDD (both diagnosed using DSM-IV-TR criteria) were enrolled from 4 psychiatric outpatient clinics in Hong Kong between May 2011 and August 2013 to undergo 9 treatment sessions across 3 weeks. They were randomly assigned to receive acupuncture, minimal acupuncture, or placebo acupuncture. The primary outcome was sleep efficiency measured by sleep diaries. Secondary outcomes included other sleep diary metrics, actigraphy data, anxiety and depressive symptoms, daytime functioning, and adverse events. The mean difference in sleep diary-derived sleep efficiency at 1-week posttreatment was -1.40 (95% CI, -7.08 to 4.28) comparing acupuncture to minimal acupuncture, and 3.10 (95% CI, -3.64 to 9.84) comparing acupuncture to placebo acupuncture. A chi-square test indicated that acupuncture resulted in a significantly higher proportion of participants achieving sleep-onset latency under 30 minutes than minimal acupuncture at 1-week posttreatment (P = .04). However, most other outcomes showed no significant differences between groups. Treatment blinding was effective, as most participants were unaware of their assigned treatment. Acupuncture was well tolerated, but its efficacy was only modest and comparable to minimal and placebo acupuncture. A large proportion of patients continued to experience clinically significant insomnia after treatment. This finding questions the value of acupuncture and highlights the challenges in treating residual insomnia in MDD. ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT01707706.

text: Although antiretroviral pre-exposure prophylaxis prevents HIV acquisition , it is not known if it alters HIV disease progression . This study assesses whether tenofovir gel impacted on disease progression among CAPRISA 004 microbicide trial seroconvertors . Eighty-three seroconvertors from the tenofovir and placebo gel arms of the CAPRISA 004 trial were monitored prospectively for a minimum of 2 years by CD4 count and viral load ( VL ) . Linear mixed models were fitted to HIV VL , and log rank test was used to compare time to reach CD4 counts of < 350 cells per microliter . Median 2-week postinfection VL was 4.74 and 4.45 log copies per milliliter in women assigned to tenofovir gel ( n = 32 ) and placebo gel ( n = 51 ) ( P = 0.189 ) . Corresponding 12-month postinfection VLs were 4.24 and 3.70 log copies per milliliter ( P = 0.016 ) . After adjusting for clinical and behavioral characteristics and protective HLA alleles , mean VLs within the first 2 years were 4.51 and 4.02 log copies per milliliter in women from the tenofovir and placebo arms ( P = 0.013 ) . Among women with vaginal tenofovir measurements , mean VLs were 4.53 and 4.60 log copies per milliliter in those with detectable versus undetectable levels ( P = 0.840 ) . Overall mean CD4 counts were 463 and 514 cells per microliter in women assigned to tenofovir and placebo ( P = 0.290 ) . Thirty-two women ( 38.6 % ) reached CD4 counts of < 350 cells per microliter at median 9.4 months postinfection , 13 ( 40.6 % ) from the tenofovir and 19 ( 37.3 % ) from the placebo arms ( P = 0.786 ) . Tenofovir gel had no impact on postinfection CD4 counts or the rate of CD4 decline . Although seroconvertors from the tenofovir arm experienced higher VLs , this did not result in a need for earlier antiretroviral therapy .
